title: basic-auth secret key is validated in the mlflow server parent before workers spawn
answers: mlflow server basic-auth keeps restarting workers and never exits
MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY not set causes crash loop
why does mlflow server endlessly show CSRF secret key traceback
basic-auth startup fails fast without secret key
body:
Symptom: `mlflow server --app-name basic-auth` with MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY unset keeps restarting crashed workers, prints the "A static secret key needs to be set for CSRF protection" error repeatedly, and never exits.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:create_app raised the secret-key MlflowException, and create_app runs inside every uvicorn worker, so the supervisor respawned each crashed worker.
Fix pattern: the check lives in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:get_flask_server_secret_key, called from the parent-process pre-flight mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth so the command fails once before any worker is spawned. create_app still calls the same helper.
Constraints: applies only when app_name is basic-auth. Do not remove the check from create_app; the factory is also used by waitress, gunicorn and embedding callers that never pass through the CLI pre-flight.
applies: Any change to basic-auth startup validation in mlflow/server/__init__.py or mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
says: Launching the server with authentication enters an endless crash loop when secrets are unset.
The server continuously restarts workers and repeatedly prints CSRF secret key errors without exiting.
Starting the service without configured CSRF protection should fail fast instead of endlessly looping.
Server startup should exit immediately with an error if the secret key is missing.
search: Basic-auth secret key validation via get_flask_server_secret_key in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py must run in parent pre-flight mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth before spawning uvicorn workers. This prevents `mlflow server --app-name basic-auth` with unset MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY from entering an infinite worker crash loop printing CSRF protection errors. Applies to basic-auth startup validation; create_app must retain the check because waitress, gunicorn, and embedded callers do not use CLI pre-flight.
